edges.reason: mint() reads _price to compute the ETH cost.
Caller-supplied mint quantity drives mint().
mint() computes costForMintingPunks from _price and quantity.
mint() delegates actual minting to the internal _mint().
mint() caches totalSupply() for the supply check.
Refund of excess ETH is sent to the caller-controlled address.
mint() performs an external ETH transfer before finishing state updates.
External transfer can call back into mint()/receive logic of the caller.
freeRollMint() calls the internal _mint() routine.
freeRollMint() reads the caller's free roll balance.
msg.sender keys the free roll lookup and reset in freeRollMint().
freeRollMint() stores the caller's free rolls into toMint.
freeRollMint() clamps the mint amount by remaining supply.
_mint() enforces the MAX_MINTABLE_AT_ONCE constant.
_mint() reads and updates _numAvailableTokens.
Internal mint quantity parameter controls the _mint() loop.
_mint() assigns the randomly selected token id to newTokenId.
_mint() maintains a working copy of available tokens.
_mint() calls useRandomAvailableToken() for each token.
_numToFetch feeds the randomness seed.
Loop index _i feeds the randomness seed.
msg.sender is mixed into the pseudo-random seed used for token selection.
block.timestamp is used as a miner-influenceable randomness input.
useRandomAvailableToken() computes a block-value-based pseudo-random number.
Weak randomness result flows back into token selection.
Keccak hash is stored in randomNum.
randomNum modulo available tokens yields randomIndex.
useRandomAvailableToken() calls useAvailableTokenAtIndex().
Pool index parameter drives the swap-and-pop resolution.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex() reads _availableTokens.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex() reads _numAvailableTokens for the last index.

useAvailableTokenAtIndex() writes the moved value back into _availableTokens.
useAvailableTokenAtIndex() decrements _numAvailableTokens.

startSale() sets isSaleOn to true.
startSale() sets saleHasBeenStarted to true.

contractURI() reads punkcontractURI.
